recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的病灶由梭形到卵圓形、胞質淡嗜酸性的細胞組成，伴隨纖維化，中央包著一團深染的小淋巴球聚集，周圍骨髓有嗜酸性球；這種「淋巴聚集被梭形肥大細胞包圍」的病灶是系統性肥大細胞增生症的典型切片表現。
features: Spindled to ovoid cells with oval bland nuclei and pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Central dense aggregate of small dark lymphocytes within the lesion
Associated reticulin-type fibrosis and loose collagenous stroma
Surrounding cellular marrow with fat spaces and scattered eosinophils
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a focal lesion adjacent to a bony trabecula composed of spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, set in fibrotic stroma. A central aggregate of small mature lymphocytes is present within the lesion, and eosinophils are seen in the surrounding cellular marrow. This mixed lesion, with spindle cells encircling a lymphoid aggregate, is characteristic of a mast cell lesion. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are composed of lymphocytes alone without a surrounding cuff of spindled tryptase-positive mast cells and fibrosis.
Granulomas contain epithelioid histiocytes with plump nuclei and often giant cells, which are CD68-positive and tryptase-negative.
PMF shows diffuse fibrosis with atypical clustered megakaryocytes rather than a discrete spindle cell nodule.
Lymphoma nodules are dominated by monotonous clonal lymphoid cells, and the spindle cells are not mast cells.
